treatment_label: cartel breakup (reverse event; untreated state = collusion)
published_source: Printed Table 2, Panel B, column (12) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.01838.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output in authors_code_* to the printed decimals. Earlier: Article tables not available in the project (no data/text file). authors_code_* = output of the authors' Replicate.R line 655 on the shipped final data (README: the package reproduces all tables). Table/column labels follow the section comments in Replicate.R (unverified against the article).
replication_status: exact (fixest with the authors' FE reproduces Replicate.R line 655: -0.072842 vs felm -0.072842, SE 0.062804 vs 0.062804, N 149289; article table unavailable)
notes: Kang (2025), 'Price-Fixing Cartels and Firm Innovation', Management Science 71(11). Package: Replicate.R + final cleaned/merged .rds files (real processed data; raw DOJ/VitalLaw, PatentsView and licensed Compustat not shipped). FE: unit + 4-digit-NAICS (patents) or Compustat industry group (R&D) x year (authors: felm(... | assignee_id + paste0(cl, year) | 0 | cl)); here xt_vars = naics4 (= cl) so the time FE is year + year x cl; SE clustered by cl. No controls, no weights. Outcomes are IHS-transformed counts/amounts, precomputed as ihs_* (log(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)), as in Replicate.R). REVERSE EVENT (cartel breakup), eligible under ruling 5b(b) (single indicator; all 122 treated pre-breakup rows are post-formation collusion years, verified). Sample exactly as Replicate.R line 655: treated gvkeys at TimeToY in {-4..-1, 1..4} (0 = breakup fiscal year, dropped), all controls, minus the breakup-window singleton list -> flag s_T2_c12. gvar g_break = breakup fiscal year; D = 1[fyear >= g_break] equals TreatY x POST row by row. Pipeline-sample TWFE (raw units) = -0.072842 vs authors -0.072842 (-0.00%). Unit id gid = 'g' + gvkey (one-to-one with gvkey): with the raw character gvkey (leading zeros, e.g. '001001'), fixest::sparse_model_matrix inside did2s names the FE '1001', 10,684 of 13,919 gvkey columns come out all-zero, the sparse solve fails and did2s falls back to a dense SVD that did not finish in 18 min; the prefix changes no estimate (TWFE/CSA unaffected; did2s point estimate unaffected, its SE was being computed on a corrupted first-stage matrix).
